$comment: TrafficSense — Canonical Data Contracts (Phase 0). All inter-module payloads must conform to these schemas. Version: 1.0.0

NormalizedEvent.$comment: Output of the Signal Normalizer / Adapter. Every ingested signal (CCTV, telemetry, complaint, weather) is converted to this shape before being passed to the decision engine.

event_id.description: UUID v4 assigned by the Signal Normalizer at ingest time.

signal_type.description: Semantic type of the detected signal.

value.description: Numeric payload: speed in km/h, stopped duration in seconds, rain in mm, anomaly confidence 0–1, complaint count, etc.

source.description: Origin system that produced this event.

source_weight.description: Trust multiplier applied during confidence scoring. Fleet vehicles = 1.5, CCTV = 1.3, complaint = 1.0, telemetry = 1.0, weather = 0.8.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the original signal.

meta.description: Optional extra context (vehicle_type, complaint_category, photo_url, etc.). Free-form but should be JSON-serialisable.

RoadSegment.$comment: Static road segment definition. Stored in SQLite and seeded from /seed/segments.json. Treated as read-only at runtime unless an authority action changes 'has_cctv'.

has_cctv.description: True = this segment already has existing CCTV — cctv_runner.py targets this segment.

baseline_speed_kmh.description: Expected average speed (km/h) keyed by hour-of-day string '00'–'23'. Unlisted hours use nearest neighbour.

flood_prone.description: True = historically floods; enables the Flood Risk (YELLOW) Evaluator for this segment.

flood_rain_threshold_mm.description: Rainfall (mm/hr) at which YELLOW flood-risk is raised. Null if flood_prone is false.

flood_severe_threshold_mm.description: Rainfall (mm/hr) at which the evaluator directly contributes to RED confidence. Null if flood_prone is false.

road_type.description: Road classification — affects priority scoring weights.

speed_limit_kmh.description: Posted speed limit on this segment.

CentralState.$comment: Single source of truth for a road segment's live status. Written by the decision engine and authority actions; read by both UIs and the rerouting block.

state.description: GREEN = normal, YELLOW = early alert / flood risk, RED = confirmed disruption.

stage.description: 0 = no alert (GREEN), 1 = Early Alert (first signals seen), 2 = Confirmed (multi-signal reinforced).

confidence.description: Composite confidence score from the Two-Stage Escalation Block (0 = no evidence, 1 = fully confirmed).

reason.description: Comma-separated list of contributing signals, e.g. 'flood_risk,speed_drop,cctv_anomaly'.

disruption_type.description: Best-guess disruption category. Null when state is GREEN.

affected_count.description: Estimated number of vehicles affected / detected in the disruption window.

alt_routes.description: Human-readable alternate route descriptions, e.g. 'Via SEG_005 → SEG_012 (+8 min)'.

alt_route_details.description: Machine-readable alternate route objects for the Commuter UI to render.

suggested_action.description: Recommended next action for the Traffic Authority.

priority_score.description: Priority ranking score = confidence × affected_count × stage_weight × road_type_weight. Higher = more urgent.

authority_action.description: Last action taken by a Traffic Authority officer. Null if no authority action yet.

authority_officer_id.description: Officer ID who took the last authority action.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent state update.

valid_until.description: If set, the state auto-expires to GREEN after this time (used for simulated events in demo).

ComplaintPayload.$comment: Submitted by a commuter via the Commuter Interface. POST /api/ingest/complaint

category.description: Disruption type reported by the commuter.

photo_url.description: Optional URL of an uploaded photo (future: handled via object storage).

reporter_type.description: Fleet reporters receive a higher source_weight (1.5 vs 1.0) in the normalizer.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp — set by the client.

AuthorityAction.$comment: One-click action from the Traffic Authority Dashboard. POST /api/authority/action. Writes directly to CentralState.

action.description: close = mark road officially closed (triggers RED). resolve = mark disruption resolved (returns to GREEN). divert = issue diversion notice. dispatch = send field team. monitor = acknowledge but keep watching.

officer_id.description: ID of the Traffic Authority officer taking the action.

note.description: Optional action note or dispatch instructions.

CCTVEvent.$comment: Raw output payload from cctv_runner.py. POST /api/ingest/cctv. The Signal Normalizer converts this to a NormalizedEvent with signal_type='cctv_anomaly'.

source.description: Always 'cctv' — identifies this as a CCTV runner event.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the analysed window.

frame_range.description: [start_frame, end_frame] of the analysed video window.

vehicle_count.description: Total vehicles detected by YOLOv8n in this window.

stopped_count.description: Vehicles classified as stopped (centre-point displacement < 5px across sampled frames for >= 30s simulated time).

slow_count.description: Vehicles moving significantly slower than the segment's time-of-day baseline.

anomaly_confidence.description: Composite score = (stopped_count + 0.5 * slow_count) / max(vehicle_count, 1). Clipped to [0, 1]. >= 0.5 triggers RED contribution.

dominant_class.description: Most frequent YOLO-detected vehicle class in this window.

raw_classes.description: Raw per-class detection counts from YOLOv8n COCO output.

model.description: YOLO model file used for inference.

TelemetryPing.$comment: Speed/stop ping from a commuter phone or fleet GPS. POST /api/ingest/telemetry

speed_kmh.description: Current vehicle speed in km/h. 0 = stopped.

stopped_duration_sec.description: How long the vehicle has been stopped (seconds). Null if moving.

SimulatorEvent.$comment: Payload for the Demo Event & Rain Simulator. POST /api/demo/simulate. Allows injecting any signal type for a live demo.

type.description: Type of event to inject. 'reset' returns segment to GREEN.

params.description: Event-specific parameters. rain→{rain_mm}, speed→{speed_kmh, count}, stop→{stopped_sec, count}, complaint→{category}, cctv_anomaly→{anomaly_confidence}.

RainfallReading.$comment: Internal structure — Live Rainfall Fetcher output per zone. Cached in memory / SQLite for 60 seconds.

rain_mm_per_hour.description: Current precipitation intensity in mm/hr from Open-Meteo.

rain_1h_accumulated_mm.description: 1-hour accumulated rainfall in mm — used for flood threshold comparison.

source.description: Whether this reading came live from Open-Meteo, the in-memory cache, or the offline fallback JSON.

api_endpoints.$comment: Canonical API contract reference. Backend (Track B) MUST implement these exactly. All other tracks consume them.

source_weight_reference.$comment: Applied by the Signal Normalizer for every event. Higher weight = more influence on confidence score.

escalation_thresholds.$comment: Two-Stage Confidence & Escalation Block reference values. Tune here, import in backend logic.
